decisions.reason: The source changes the SK6812 supply and data-level-shifter design, not the sensor-board connector inventory or sensor-module interfaces.
The standalone USB 3.3V regulator, capacity, activation condition, and powered load remain unchanged.
The source does not change the AXP2101 battery or USB power path.
The eight-LED board and its SK6812 LED family remain required unchanged; the source concerns electrical supply and data translation.
Powering the SK6812 LEDs from the existing 5V rail does not change the requirement to monitor the 3.3V and 5V rails.
The source does not alter any interboard connector, pinout, or board power-distribution topology.
The SK6812 electrical decision does not affect the SPS30 SEL-to-GND I2C mode selection.
The source does not discuss or resolve the battery connector series, mounting, or pinout.
The candidate already contains a complete same-message MODIFY recording the 5V LED supply, required level shifting, and 74AHCT1G125 part selection.
The source preserves use of the 5V rail and does not change the existing GPIO-controlled standby cutoff behavior.
The source does not affect the ESP32 BOOT button, reset connection, or associated capacitances.
The source references ESP32 output voltage only to justify level shifting and does not change the selected ESP32 module or breakout requirement.
